30–60 min (while the world change is active)

When the river south of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} overflows, a small new island becomes accessible with a spawn of 11 {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}. Kill 50 of them in the dungeon to get the achievement **Down the Drain**.
New island south of the Outlaw Camp
Only while this Mini World Change is active.
Hunting supplies (potions, runes) to kill 50 Water Elementals
Check on the {wiki:World Board} that the world change is active before you go.

This Mini World Change is active when you see one of these messages: *"The river south of the outlaw camp is flooding. A small island there should now be reachable safely."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! A river is flooding, south of the outlaw base. Explore a new isle, an unknown place. Don't be afraid, but ready your blade."*

The {wiki:Outlaw Camp} is **east of Thais** and **west of Venore** (west of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}). Leave Thais by the east gate (or Venore by the west gate) and follow the road on foot to the camp ({coord:32643,32222,7}).

From the Outlaw Camp head **south**, to the river that has overflowed: the small island ({coord:32589,32308,7}) is only accessible while the world change is active. On the way you may meet {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} and {creature:Bandit|Bandits}. There is also 1 {creature:Water Elemental} on the surface.
The island on the surface, with the cave entrance

On the island, go down into the cave at {coord:32590,32314,7}; you arrive 1 floor below, at {coord:32590,32314,8}. Careful: the 10 {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} in the cave can all come at the same time when you go down.
The Water Elementals in the cave can attack you all at once right at the entrance.
In the {wiki:Outlaw Camp/Water Elemental Dungeon|Water Elemental dungeon} (a spawn of 11, 10 in the cave and 1 on the surface) kill **50** {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals}.

Leave the same way you went down ({coord:32590,32314,8}) and return to the island. Then walk back north to the Outlaw Camp, and from there to Thais (west) or Venore (east). Do this before the world change ends, because the island is only accessible while the river is overflowing.
